title: Do AI Coding Agents Write Infrastructure as Code Like Humans? An Empirical Study of GitHub Pull Requests
abstract: arXiv:2610.34613v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) configurations define cloud resources, networking, and access control, and AI coding agents increasingly write them. Little is known about how agent contributions differ from those of humans and automation bots, how maintainers evaluate them, and whether they introduce different sustainability concerns.   We study 349,156 IaC pull requests (PRs) from 49,241 GitHub repositories, distinguishing humans, automation bots, silent agents, and disclosed agents. Bots account for 32.9% of ostensibly human PRs, and 12.3% of the remaining PRs contain agent traces, a share that grows over the study period. Agent PRs are about four times larger than human PRs and more often modify core infrastructure modules, whereas bots mainly maintain dependencies. Silent-agent PRs have higher overall merge rates than human PRs (87.4% vs. 78.9%) but are merged 4.0 percentage points less often within the same repositories. Disclosed agen

translated_title: AI编码代理像人类一样编写基础设施即代码吗？——基于GitHub拉取请求的实证研究
translated_abstract: 基础设施即代码配置定义了云资源、网络和访问控制，而AI编码代理正越来越多地编写这些配置。目前人们对代理的贡献与人类及自动化机器人有何不同、维护者如何评估这些贡献，以及它们是否引入不同的可持续性问题知之甚少。我们研究了来自49,241个GitHub仓库的349,156个IaC拉取请求（PR），区分了人类、自动化机器人、未披露代理和已披露代理。结果显示，机器人占表面上由人类提交的PR的32.9%，其余PR中有12.3%包含代理痕迹，且这一比例在研究期间持续增长。代理PR的规模约为人类PR的四倍，且更常修改核心基础设施模块，而机器人主要负责维护依赖项。未披露代理的PR的总体合并率高于人类PR（87.4%对78.9%），但在同一仓库内其合并率却低4.0个百分点。已披露代理的相关情况（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该研究首次大规模实证分析了34.9万个GitHub IaC拉取请求，发现AI编码代理编写的PR规模约为人类的四倍且更常改动核心基础设施模块，尽管其总体合并率更高，但在同一仓库内却比人类PR更难获得维护者的合并认可。
en_tdlr: This first large-scale empirical study of 349,156 GitHub IaC pull requests reveals that AI coding agents produce PRs roughly four times larger than humans' and more often modify core infrastructure modules, achieving higher overall merge rates but lower within-repository merge acceptance than human contributors.
